label: Findings that block a directory submission
means: Plugin findings the developer portal marks Blocking, or that stop its validation.
goal_source: Anthropic's plugin pre-submission checklist (claude.com/docs/plugins/pre-submission-checklist, read 2026-11-15): a plugin cannot be submitted until every Blocks finding is fixed
source: every file git ls-files -s lists (else a walk of the repo less params.skip_dirs), and each plugin folder holding .claude-plugin/plugin.json outside params.skip_dirs, checked against each blocks row of collectors/practices/practices-rules.mjs; the 50 MiB archive and 256 MiB unpacked sizes and the name-taken check need the portal and are not read; detail is each finding's file, rule and doc

params.comment: skip_dirs: folders no plugin or .claude/skills folder is looked for in, and that a walk outside git skips; the repo-wide counts read all git lists. eval_reports: one aggregate-result.json per model from claude plugin eval, <plugin> the manifest name, relative to the repo root.

label: Findings held for an Anthropic reviewer
means: Plugin findings the portal holds for a reviewer, so a version waits before it can go live.
goal_source: Anthropic's plugin pre-submission checklist (read 2026-11-15): a Policy hold, and each choice a reviewer always checks, waits for a reviewer before the version goes live
source: each holds row of collectors/practices/practices-rules.mjs, the checklist's Policy hold rows and its choices a reviewer always checks, on each plugin folder; the security scan after submission is not run

label: Directory warnings
means: Plugin findings the portal shows as warnings: submittable, but worth fixing.
goal_source: Anthropic's plugin pre-submission checklist (read 2026-11-15) lists each warning with its fix; template goal: fix them all
source: each warning row of collectors/practices/practices-rules.mjs on each plugin folder

label: Directory listing fields missing
means: Listing fields a plugin.json leaves out: icon, the four links, displayName, keywords and homepage.
goal_source: Claude Code plugin manifest reference, Directory listing fields (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference, read 2026-11-15): the directory reads them for the listing; template goal: set them all
source: each readable plugin.json: icon (an image path inside the plugin), documentationUrl, supportUrl, privacyPolicyUrl and termsOfServiceUrl (https URLs), displayName, keywords and homepage; blank or of the wrong form counts as missing

label: Skill authoring rules broken
means: Skill names, descriptions and frontmatter that break Anthropic's authoring rules.
goal_source: Anthropic's skill authoring best practices (platform.claude.com, read 2026-11-15) and the Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io/specification, read 2026-11-15) set each rule
source: each SKILL.md of each plugin and of the repo's .claude/skills: name 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, no leading, trailing or double hyphen, its folder's name, no anthropic or claude; description 1 to 1,024 characters, no XML tags, third person, saying when; description and when_to_use within 1,536 characters; a plugin skill uses only the fields claude.ai and the Skills API accept

label: Skill files past the size and layout rules
means: Skill bodies of 500 lines or more, long references with no contents list, nested references and backslash paths.
goal_source: Anthropic's skill authoring best practices (read 2026-11-15): a SKILL.md body under 500 lines, a contents list atop a reference file over 100 lines, references one level deep, forward slashes
source: each skill folder: the SKILL.md body's lines; each other .md file's lines, a contents heading or anchor list in its first 30 lines, and a link to another .md file in the folder; a path with a backslash in any of them

label: Skills that run tools they do not name
means: Skills whose code runs a command-line tool that neither compatibility nor a Requires line names.
goal_source: Anthropic's skill authoring best practices (read 2026-11-15): list required packages; the Agent Skills specification's compatibility field names them
source: each skill's code spans and fenced blocks, a command at the start or after a pipe, ; or &&: gh, git, claude, npm, npx, node, python, python3, pip, uv, uvx, docker, wrangler, jq or curl; named when its compatibility field or a body line starting Requires holds the word

label: Largest plugin's always-on tokens
means: Tokens the largest plugin's skill, command and agent names and descriptions add to every session.
goal_source: template goal; near band: the /plugin details pane highlights an always-on figure of 2,000 tokens or more (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/measure, read 2026-11-15)
source: for each plugin, the characters of each skill's, command's and agent's name, description and when_to_use, over 4, summed; the largest plugin's sum; detail is each component's tokens

label: Plugin skills with fewer than three eval cases
means: Plugin skills that fewer than three claude plugin eval cases prove fired.
goal_source: Anthropic's skill authoring best practices (read 2026-11-15): at least three evaluations per skill
source: each case folder <plugin>/evals/*/ with a prompt.md or case.yaml, whose graders/*.md has type tool_used, tool Skill and an input_match regex that matches "skill": "<plugin>:<skill>"

label: Plugin skills not shown to beat no plugin
means: Plugin skills whose eval cases do not beat the no-plugin baseline on every model report.
goal_source: Anthropic's skill authoring best practices (read 2026-11-15): test with Haiku, Sonnet and Opus; claude plugin eval reports each case's delta against no plugin (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-evals, read 2026-11-15)
source: each of params.eval_reports, an aggregate-result.json with schemaVersion 1: a skill lifts when the mean cases[].aggregates.delta of the cases that prove it fired is above 0 in every report; a missing report or one with partial true shows no lift
